decision.observation: North-up view: car still at 0 mph facing north, positioned right against a power pole; wobbling gear dots show throttle applied but the car isn't moving. The asphalt runs diagonally from bottom-center to the upper-right, only a few meters east of the car.
decision.hypothesis: The car is wedged against the power pole, blocking forward motion; reversing straight back should free it, then a right steer can put it on the asphalt.
decision.memory: Power poles planted on this grass verge snag the car. S straight back is the standard escape from a pole snag.
